description: This file contains unit tests for broadcast channel functionality in an Orleans-based distributed system, including tests for fire-and-forget and non-fire-and-forget delivery modes with multiple subscribers.

classes.name: BroadcastChannelTests
classes.description: Unit test class for broadcast channel functionality in Orleans, testing various delivery modes and subscriber scenarios.

methods.name: ClientPublishSingleChannelTest
methods.description: Tests publishing to a single broadcast channel with a single subscriber.

methods.name: ClientPublishSingleChannelMultipleConsumersTest
methods.description: Tests publishing to a single channel with multiple subscribers.

methods.name: MultipleSubscribersOneBadActorChannelTest
methods.description: Tests behavior with multiple subscribers including a bad actor.

methods.name: NonFireAndForgetClientPublishSingleChannelTest
methods.description: Tests non-fire-and-forget publishing mode on a single channel.

methods.name: NonFireAndForgetClientPublishMultipleChannelTest
methods.description: Tests non-fire-and-forget publishing mode across multiple channels.

methods.name: NonFireAndForgetClientPublishSingleChannelMultipleConsumersTest
methods.description: Tests non-fire-and-forget mode with multiple subscribers.

methods.name: NonFireAndForgetMultipleSubscribersOneBadActorChannelTest
methods.description: Tests non-fire-and-forget mode with a bad actor among subscribers.
